name: Asinius Quadratus
bio: Asinius Quadratus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 3rd century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 312).

poems.title: Book VII, 312: On those slain by Sulla
poems.author: Asinius Quadratus
poems.text: They who took up arms against the Romans lie exhibiting the tokens of their valour. Not one died wounded in the back, but all alike perished by a secret treacherous death.
